changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwpayorplan AS SELECT pp.id, pp.payor_id, pp.name, pp.plan_type, pp.is_active, pp.created_date, pp.created_by, pp.last_modified_by, pp.last_modified_date, pp.network_id, pp.coverage_type, pp.payer_nphies_id, pp.waseel_plan_id FROM public.payor_plan pp;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwpayorplan TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwpayorplan FROM report_user;
